_about: Manual curation, decided by eye from results/figures/mask_qc_sheet.png (late registered reference + plant mask per run). exclude_boxes are raw-pixel rectangles [x0, y0, x1, y1] of bright off-plant objects; they are removed from both the plant mask and the background model. mask_ok=false keeps a run out of the pooled regional comparison.

expt01.note: field of view jumps ~3 mm at ~96 s; analysis starts after

expt02.note: single floating leaf; drifts and rotates (see motion flag)

expt03.note: bright out-of-focus objects behind the mesh are interleaved with leaves; mask mixes them

expt04.note: rosette badly out of focus; 4-min run

expt05.note: a few bright mesh holes enter the mask (small)

expt08.note: bright off-plant blob in a mesh hole, left of the rosette

expt09.note: a few small bright mesh holes at upper left enter the mask

expt10.note: dim plant; bright objects at the bottom edge already excluded by size

expt11.note: large bright debris clump at upper left dominated the mask

expt12.note: saturated chevron object excluded by the clipped threshold
